text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Umm, Bright-san? There's no particular 
reason or anything, but... around what 
time will you be heading back to your room 
today~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see~... Today happens to be a 
rather special day~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to buy some clothes for my 
doll~. So I'll probably be back around 
evening time~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If you need something, I could head home 
early~...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah— no no! Not at all! Please prioritize 
your errands!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If anything, please take your time and 
relax even more. In the meantime, I shall—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaah *cough* *hack*! *cough* 
*cough*... It went down the wrong pipe!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, are you alright~? Please take good 
care of yourself~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Oh, right! Bright-san. Didn't you 
say you weren't good with cakes and sweet 
things?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I love cake! Especially when enjoying it 
with black tea, it makes me feel sooo very 
happy~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm... I see! Eating cake along with 
black tea... is it?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, that was so helpful! 
I'll be sure to prepare some delicious 
black tea and cake!
